first_review: Old 48 and 96 closed-loop paths were evaluated before design; no new input drawn before writing this file.
selection_rule: Within +1% development support-MSE per group relative to V1a, minimize mean then maximum paired pre-alarm risk change in six primary groups. Break ties by smallest average shortfall from full weight, then larger lambda. If no eligible, freeze largest lambda for diagnostic only.
test_rule: Lock lambda before validation. Health joint one-sided 95% <=2%. MSE support relative margin +1% as declared screening convention. Primary risk groups are two models by unknown start / A1-H / A1-C, paired risk intervals and six-group simultaneous 95% upper. Timing mismatch is secondary. No tuning on independent data.
alarm: First original mixture BF >=20. The action chosen from the raw packet is pre-alarm only when no alarm occurred through that update. Strict tau_D < tau_A.
scope: Five-node receiver and offline frozen distortions. Unknown starts uniform from 3, 7, 11; timing variation stops after 8 instead of 10. A1 replays select bank rows before observing current packets. Existing joint historical records are separate development evidence.
